cards.name: Accelerate Plans
cards.text: Choose 1 of your agents assigned to Waterdeep Harbor.  Return it to your pool, then immediately assign 2 agents.

cards.name: Ambush
cards.text: Each opponent removes a fighter from his or her Tavern and returns it to the supply.  For each opponent that could not do so, take a fighter from the supply and place it in your Tavern.

cards.name: Arcane Mishap
cards.text: Each opponent removes a wizard from his or her Tavern and returns it to the supply.  For each opponent that could not do so, draw an Intrigue card.

cards.name: Assassination
cards.text: Each opponent removes a rogue from his or her Tavern and returns it to the supply.  For each opponent that could not do so, take 2 gold from the supply and place it in your Tavern.

cards.name: Bidding War
cards.text: Draw quests from the deck equal to the number of players.  Keep one and pass the remaining quests to the player on your left.  Each player, in turn, chooses one quest to keep and passes the rest to the left until every player has taken a quest.

cards.name: Bribe Agent
cards.text: Choose an action space containing an opponent's agent.  You use that space's action as though you had assigned an agent to it.

cards.name: Call for Adventurers
cards.text: Take 2 adventurers from the supply and place them in your Tavern.  Each opponent takes an adventurers from the supply and places it in his or her Tavern.

cards.name: Change of Plans
cards.text: Discard an uncompleted Quest.  Score 6 points.  Each opponent can choose to discard an uncompleted quest to score 3 points.  (You can discard a Mandatory Quest in this way.)

cards.name: Conscription
cards.text: Take 2 fighters from the supply and place them in your Tavern.  Choose 1 opponent.  That opponent takes a fighter from the supply and places it in his or her Tavern.

cards.name: Crime Wave
cards.text: Take 2 rogues from the supply and place them in your Tavern.  Choose 1 opponent.  That opponent takes a rogue from the supply and places it in his or her Tavern.

cards.name: Free Drinks!
cards.text: Remove an adventurer from an opponent's Tavern, and then place it in your Tavern.

cards.name: Good Faith
cards.text: Take 2 clerics from the supply and place them in your Tavern.  Choose 1 opponent.  That opponent takes a cleric from the supply and places it in his or her Tavern.

cards.name: Graduation Day
cards.text: Take 2 wizards from the supply and place them in your Tavern.  Choose 1 opponent.  That opponent takes a wizard from the supply and places it in his or her Tavern.

cards.name: Lack of Faith
cards.text: Each opponent removes a cleric from his or her Tavern and returns it to the supply.  For each opponent that could not do so, you score 2 points.

cards.name: Real Estate Deal
cards.text: Discard a Building under your control that currently has no agent assigned to it.  Then choose 1 Building in Builder's Hall and put it in play under your control at no cost.  (Replace that Building afterward.)

cards.name: Recall Agent
cards.text: Return 1 of your assigned agents to your pool.

cards.name: Recruit Spies
cards.text: Take 2 rogues from the supply and place them in your Tavern.  Each opponent can choose to give you a rogue once to score 3 points.  (Place it in your Tavern.)

cards.name: Request Assistance
cards.text: Take 2 fighters from the supply and place them in your Tavern.  Each opponent can choose to give you a fighter once to score 3 points.  (Place it in your Tavern.)

cards.name: Research Agreement
cards.text: Take 2 wizards from the supply and place them in your Tavern.  Each opponent can choose to give you a wizard once to score 5 points.  (Place it in your Tavern.)

cards.name: Sample Wares
cards.text: Assign 1 of your unused agents to a Building in Builder's Hall.  You immediately use the effect of that Builder as though you controlled it.

cards.name: Special Assignment
cards.text: Choose a Quest type: Arcana, Commerce, Piety, Skullduggery, or Warfare.  Draw and reveal quests until you reveal a card of the chosen type.  Keep that quest and discard the rest.

cards.name: Spread the Wealth
cards.text: Take 4 gold from the supply and choose 1 opponent.  That opponent takes 2 gold from the supply.

cards.name: Summon the Faithful
cards.text: Take 2 clerics from the supply and place them in your Tavern.  Each opponent can choose to give you a cleric once to score 5 points.  (Place it in your Tavern.)

cards.name: Tax Collection
cards.text: Take 4 gold from the supply.  Each opponent can choose to pay you 4 gold once to score 4 points.

cards.name: Rapid Expansion
cards.text: Pay 5 gold.  Look at the top 5 Buildings in the Building stack.  Put 1 of those Buildings into play under your control at no cost and put the rest on the bottom of the stack.

cards.name: Black Market Money
cards.text: Take 9 gold from the supply and 1 corruption from the Corruption track and place them in your Tavern.  Each opponent can take 4 gold and 1 corruption and place them in his or her Tavern.

cards.name: Blackmail
cards.text: Choose 1 opponent.  Remove 2 gold from his or her Tavern and place it in your Tavern.  Look at that opponent's Lord card.

cards.name: Bribe the Watch
cards.text: Spend 2 gold: Return up to 2 corruption from your Tavern to the Corruption track.  Each opponent can spend 4 gold to return 1 corruption to the Corruption track.

cards.name: Corrupting Influence
cards.text: Place 1 corruption from the Corruption track on each of 2 different action spaces.

cards.name: Dark Dagger Assassination
cards.text: Take 4 rogues from the supply and 1 corruption from the Corruption track, and place them in your Tavern.  Each opponent can take 2 rogues and 1 corruption and place them in his or her Tavern.

cards.name: Donations for Cyric
cards.text: Take 2 clerics from the supply and 1 corruption from the Corruption track, and place them in your Tavern.  Each opponent can take a cleric and 1 corruption and place them in his or her Tavern.

cards.name: Doppelganger
cards.text: Choose an action space containing an agent of an opponent with more corruption than you.  You use that space's action as though you had assigned an agent to it.

cards.name: Expose Corruption
cards.text: Each opponent with more corruption than you takes 1 corruption from the Corruption track and places it in his or her Tavern.

cards.name: Foist Responsibility
cards.text: Take 1 corruption from the Corruption track, place it in your Tavern, and give 1 of your uncompleted Mandatory Quests to an opponent with at least 1 corruption.

cards.name: Forge Deed
cards.text: Take 2 corruption from the Corruption track, place them in your Tavern, and gain control of 1 Building under an opponent's control.

cards.name: Honorable Example
cards.text: Score 6 points if each opponent has more corruption than you.

cards.name: Iron Ring Slaves
cards.text: Take 4 fighters from the supply and 1 corruption from the Corruption track, and place them in your Tavern.  Each opponent can take 2 fighters and 1 corruption and place them in his or her Tavern.

cards.name: Mind Flayer Mercenaries
cards.text: Take 2 wizards from the supply and 1 corruption from the Corruption track, and place them in your Tavern.  Each opponent can take a wizard and 1 corruption and place them in his or her Tavern.

cards.name: Release the Hounds
cards.text: Take 3 corruption from the Corruption track and remove them from the game.

cards.name: Repent
cards.text: Return 1 corruption from your Tavern to the Corruption track.

cards.name: Scapegoat
cards.text: Return 1 adventurer to the supply and up to 2 corruption to the Corruption track from your Tavern.  Each opponent can return 2 adventurers and 1 corruption from his or her Tavern.

cards.name: Allied Faiths
cards.text: Give 1 opponent a cleric from your Tavern and score 8 points.

cards.name: Architectural Innovation
cards.text: Take 2 gold from the supply and place it in your Tavern.  You can purchase 1 face-up Building in Builder's Hall.

cards.name: Call for Assistance
cards.text: Choose 1 opponent.  Remove 2 fighters, 2 rogues, or a fighter and rogue from his or her Tavern and place them in your Tavern.

cards.name: Demolish
cards.text: Choose 1 Building in play that has no agent assigned to it and discard it.  If you were not the owner, pay the Gold cost of that Building to its owner.  Put 1 Building in Builder's Hall in play under your control at no cost.

cards.name: Friendly Loan
cards.text: Give 1 opponent 4 gold from your Tavern and score 8 points.

cards.name: Honor Among Thieves
cards.text: Give 1 opponent 2 rogues from your Tavern and score 8 points.

cards.name: Inevitable Betrayal
cards.text: Choose 1 opponent.  Remove an adventurer and 2 gold from his or her Tavern and place them in your Tavern.  Give this card to the chosen opponent after playing it.

cards.name: Information Broker
cards.text: Draw 3 Intrigue cards.  Each opponent draws 1 Intrigue card.

cards.name: Manipulate
cards.text: Choose an action space containing an opponent's agent and move that agent to an unoccupied action space.  The opponent can take the new space's action.  Then assign 1 of your unassigned agents.

cards.name: Mercenary Contract
cards.text: Give 1 opponent 2 fighters from your Tavern and score 8 points.

cards.name: Open Lord
cards.text: Reveal your Lord card and discard any of your uncompleted Mandatory Quests.  For the rest of the game, you cannot be affected by Attack and Mandatory Quest Intrigue cards played by opponents.

cards.name: Organized Crime
cards.text: Take 2 rogues from the supply and place them in your Tavern.  Place a rogue from the supply on each of 2 different action spaces.

cards.name: Preferential Treatment
cards.text: Take 2 gold from the supply and place it in your Tavern.  Take starting player.

cards.name: Proselytize
cards.text: Take a cleric from the supply and place it in your Tavern.  Place a cleric from the supply on any action space.

cards.name: Recruitment Drive
cards.text: Take 2 fighters from the supply and place them in your Tavern.  Place a fighter from the supply on each of 2 different action spaces.

cards.name: Sponsor Apprentices
cards.text: Take a wizard from the supply and place it in your Tavern.  Place a wizard from the supply on any action space.

cards.name: Tax Revolt
cards.text: Take 4 gold from the supply and place it in your Tavern.  Place 2 gold from the supply on each of 2 different action spaces.

cards.name: Unexpected Success
cards.text: Draw 2 Intrigue cards.  As you draw each card, you can play it immediately as part of this action.

cards.name: Unlikely Assistance
cards.text: Give 1 opponent a wizard from your Tavern and score 8 points.
